# espalier_networks (Data Source)

All networks in the container runtime, optionally only those with certain labels.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "espalier_networks" "all" {}

output "subnets" {
  value = { for n in data.espalier_networks.all.networks : n.name => n.subnet }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `labels` (Map of String) Only list networks that have all of these labels, with these values.

### Read-Only

- `networks` (Attributes List) The networks ordered by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--networks))

<a id="nestedatt--networks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `networks`

Read-Only:

- `gateway` (String) IPv4 gateway address of the network.
- `id` (String) The network's name.
- `internal` (Boolean) Host-only network without a route off the host (`--internal`). Defaults to `false` (NAT).
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels attached to the network.
- `name` (String) Name of the network.
- `options` (Map of String) Plugin-specific options (`--option key=value`).
- `plugin` (String) Network plugin (`--plugin`). Defaults to the runtime's, `container-network-vmnet`.
- `subnet` (String) IPv4 subnet in CIDR notation. Chosen by the runtime if not set.
- `subnet_v6` (String) IPv6 prefix in CIDR notation. Chosen by the runtime if not set.
